statement: Under the stated Gromov–Witten axioms, the rational-plane-curve counts satisfy N(1)=1 and N(d)=Σ_(k+l=d;k,l>0)N(k)N(l)k²l[l binom(3d−4,3k−2)−k binom(3d−4,3k−1)]. In particular, N(2)=1, N(3)=12, N(4)=620, and N(5)=87304.

scope: Irreducible rational degree-d plane curves through 3d−1 general points.
notes:
Historical qualification: this paper derives the recursion under its stated Gromov–Witten axioms and labels Section 5.2 Enumerative predictions; the introduction explicitly discusses the then incomplete geometric foundations.

Source discussion. Under the paper’s Gromov–Witten axioms, the degree-d rational-plane-curve counts are uniquely determined by N(1)=1 and N(d)=Σ_(k+l=d;k,l>0)N(k)N(l)k²l[l binom(3d−4,3k−2)−k binom(3d−4,3k−1)]. In particular, N(2)=1, N(3)=12, N(4)=620, and N(5)=87304. The recurrence is equivalent to associativity of the plane potential.
